title: Jersey Royal Potatoes with Floral Notes
description: A unique twist on traditional roasted potatoes, infused with floral notes and a hint of Ukrainian flair.
instructions: Peel and chop the potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
In a bowl, mix together honey, dill, and sea salt.
Add the potatoes to the bowl and toss to coat with the honey mixture.
Drizzle with aerated olive oil and toss again.
Transfer the potatoes to a baking sheet and top with babka crumbs (if using).
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with additional dill if desired.
